<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[function() {
  var c = this;

  // ── PAGE IDs (confirmed from your ServiceNow Pages list) ──
  var PAGE_IDS = {
    home:       'test_catalog',   // ← CORRECT page ID from your screenshot
    labReports: 'lab_reports'
  };

  c.loading = true;
  c.activeTab = 'all';
  c.searchQuery = '';
  c.sortBy = 'date_desc';
  c.filteredAppointments = [];
  c.showModal = false;
  c.selectedAppt = null;

  c.tabs = [
    { key: 'all',       label: 'All',       count: 0 },
    { key: 'pending',   label: 'Pending',   count: 0 },
    { key: 'confirmed', label: 'Confirmed', count: 0 },
    { key: 'completed', label: 'Completed', count: 0 },
    { key: 'cancelled', label: 'Cancelled', count: 0 }
  ];

  c.stats = [
    { icon: ']]>📋<![CDATA[', label: 'Total',     count: 0 },
    { icon: '✅', label: 'Confirmed', count: 0 },
    { icon: '⏳', label: 'Pending',   count: 0 },
    { icon: '✔️', label: 'Completed', count: 0 }
  ];

  // ── NAVIGATION ────────────────────────────────────────────
  var _nav = function(pageId) {
    var portalId = window.location.pathname.split('/')[1] || 'sp';
    window.location.href = '/' + portalId + '?id=' + pageId;
  };

  // ── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // KEY FIX: ServiceNow populates c.data synchronously BEFORE this runs.
  // $watch('data') never fires. Just read data directly in $onInit.
  c.$onInit = function() {
    c.loading = false;
    c.buildStats();
    c.filterAppointments();
  };

  c.buildStats = function() {
    var appts = c.data.appointments || [];
    c.stats[0].count = appts.length;
    c.stats[1].count = appts.filter(function(a) { return a.status === 'confirmed'; }).length;
    c.stats[2].count = appts.filter(function(a) { return a.status === 'pending';   }).length;
    c.stats[3].count = appts.filter(function(a) { return a.status === 'completed'; }).length;
    c.tabs.forEach(function(tab) {
      tab.count = (tab.key === 'all')
        ? appts.length
        : appts.filter(function(a) { return a.status === tab.key; }).length;
    });
  };

  c.setTab = function(key) { c.activeTab = key; c.filterAppointments(); };

  c.filterAppointments = function() {
    var appts = angular.copy(c.data.appointments || []);
    var q   = (c.searchQuery || '').toLowerCase();
    var tab = c.activeTab;
    c.filteredAppointments = appts.filter(function(a) {
      var matchTab    = (tab === 'all') || (a.status === tab);
      var matchSearch = !q ||
        (a.test_name          && a.test_name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1) ||
        (a.appointment_number && a.appointment_number.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1) ||
        (a.test_category      && a.test_category.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1);
      return matchTab && matchSearch;
    });
    c.sortAppointments();
  };

  c.sortAppointments = function() {
    c.filteredAppointments.sort(function(a, b) {
      if (c.sortBy === 'date_asc')  return (a.scheduled_date || '').localeCompare(b.scheduled_date || '');
      if (c.sortBy === 'date_desc') return (b.scheduled_date || '').localeCompare(a.scheduled_date || '');
      if (c.sortBy === 'status')    return (a.status || '').localeCompare(b.status || '');
      return 0;
    });
  };

  // ── STATUS HELPERS ────────────────────────────────────────
  var STATUS_MAP = {
    'pending':   { color:'#f59e0b', bg:'#fef3c7', icon:'⏳', label:'Pending'   },
    'confirmed': { color:'#3b82f6', bg:'#dbeafe', icon:'✅', label:'Confirmed' },
    'completed': { color:'#10b981', bg:'#dcfce7', icon:'✔️', label:'Completed' },
    'cancelled': { color:'#6b7280', bg:'#f1f5f9', icon:']]>🚫<![CDATA[', label:'Cancelled' },
    'rejected':  { color:'#ef4444', bg:'#fee2e2', icon:'❌', label:'Rejected'  }
  };
  var _statusProp = function(s, prop, fallback) {
    return (STATUS_MAP[s] && STATUS_MAP[s][prop]) ? STATUS_MAP[s][prop] : fallback;
  };
  c.getStatusColor = function(s) { return _statusProp(s, 'color', '#94a3b8'); };
  c.getStatusBg    = function(s) { return _statusProp(s, 'bg',    '#f1f5f9'); };
  c.getStatusIcon  = function(s) { return _statusProp(s, 'icon',  '•');       };
  c.getStatusLabel = function(s) { return _statusProp(s, 'label', s);         };

  c.getApprovalLabel = function(s) {
    var m = { 'requested':'Approval Requested','approved':'✅ Approved','rejected':'❌ Rejected' };
    return m[s] || s;
  };
  c.getPaymentLabel = function(s) {
    var m = { 'paid':'✓ Paid','pending':'Payment Pending','unpaid':'Unpaid','refunded':'Refunded' };
    return m[s] || (s || 'N/A');
  };
  c.getCategoryIcon = function(cat) {
    var icons = { 'blood':']]>🩸<![CDATA[','urine':']]>🧪<![CDATA[','imaging':']]>🩻<![CDATA[','cardiology':'❤️',
                  'neurology':']]>🧠<![CDATA[','genetics':']]>🧬<![CDATA[','pathology':']]>🔬<![CDATA[' };
    if (!cat) return ']]>🔬<![CDATA[';
    var k = cat.toLowerCase();
    for (var key in icons) { if (k.indexOf(key) !== -1) return icons[key]; }
    return ']]>🔬<![CDATA[';
  };

  c.canCancel = function(appt) {
    return appt.status === 'pending' || appt.status === 'confirmed';
  };

  // CANCEL 
  c.cancelAppointment = function(appt) {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to cancel appointment ' + appt.appointment_number + '?')) return;
    c.server.get({ action: 'cancel_appointment', appointment_sys_id: appt.sys_id })
      .then(function(response) {
        if (response.data.success) {
          appt.status = 'cancelled';
          c.buildStats();
          c.filterAppointments();
          alert('Appointment cancelled successfully.');
        } else {
          alert('Error: ' + (response.data.error || 'Failed to cancel.'));
        }
      });
  };

  // ── MODAL ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  c.viewDetails = function(appt) { c.selectedAppt = appt; c.showModal = true;  };
  c.closeModal  = function()     { c.showModal = false;   c.selectedAppt = null; };

  // ── NAVIGATION ────────────────────────────────────────────
  // KEY FIX: "Book New Test" now goes to correct page ID "test_catalog"
  c.bookNew   = function() { _nav(PAGE_IDS.home); };
  c.viewReport = function(appt) { _nav(PAGE_IDS.labReports); };
}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>.my-appts {
  --primary: #0a2463;
  --accent: #00b4d8;
  --success: #10b981;
  --warning: #f59e0b;
  --danger: #ef4444;
  --info: #3b82f6;
  --gray-50: #f8fafc;
  --gray-100: #f1f5f9;
  --gray-200: #e2e8f0;
  --gray-400: #94a3b8;
  --gray-600: #475569;
  --gray-800: #1e293b;
  --white: #ffffff;
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.09);

  font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: var(--gray-50);
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: 0 0 60px;
}

/* ---------- HEADER ---------- */
.appts-header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, #1e3a8a 100%);
  padding: 40px 40px 50px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-radius: 0 0 32px 32px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 20px;
}

.header-title {
  font-size: 32px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--white);
  margin: 0 0 8px;
}

.header-sub { color: #bfdbfe; margin: 0; font-size: 15px; }

.btn-book-new {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 24px;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--white);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,180,216,0.35);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.btn-book-new:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,180,216,0.45); }

/* ---------- STATS BAR ---------- */
.stats-bar {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 24px 40px 0;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.stat-card {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 120px;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  padding: 16px 20px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s;
}

.stat-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

.stat-icon { font-size: 28px; }
.stat-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.stat-val { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--primary); line-height: 1; }
.stat-name { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-600); font-weight: 500; margin-top: 2px; }

/* ---------- FILTER TABS ---------- */
.filter-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 24px 40px 0;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.filter-tab {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px 18px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
  background: var(--white);
  color: var(--gray-600);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.filter-tab:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }

.filter-tab.active {
  background: var(--primary);
  border-color: var(--primary);
  color: var(--white);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(10,36,99,0.25);
}

.tab-count {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 1px 7px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.filter-tab:not(.active) .tab-count {
  background: var(--gray-100);
  color: var(--gray-600);
}

/* ---------- LIST CONTROLS ---------- */
.list-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 16px 40px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.search-mini-wrap {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  max-width: 320px;
}

.search-mini-wrap .fa {
  position: absolute;
  left: 12px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  color: var(--gray-400);
}

.search-mini {
  padding: 9px 14px 9px 36px;
  border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 14px;
  width: 100%;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.2s;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.search-mini:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

.sort-mini {
  padding: 9px 14px;
  border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 14px;
  background: var(--white);
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
}

.sort-mini:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

/* ---------- LOADING ---------- */
.loading-center { text-align: center; padding: 60px; color: var(--gray-600); }
.spinner-ring {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 44px; height: 44px;
  border: 4px solid var(--gray-200);
  border-top-color: var(--accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

/* ---------- EMPTY STATE ---------- */
.empty-appts { text-align: center; padding: 60px 40px; }
.empty-emoji { font-size: 56px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.empty-appts h3 { font-size: 20px; color: var(--gray-800); margin: 0 0 8px; }
.empty-appts p { color: var(--gray-600); margin: 0 0 20px; }

.btn-book-first {
  padding: 12px 28px;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: var(--white);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.2s;
}

.btn-book-first:hover { background: #1e3a8a; }

/* ---------- APPOINTMENTS LIST ---------- */
.appts-list {
  padding: 8px 40px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

/* ---------- APPOINTMENT CARD ---------- */
.appt-card {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
}

.appt-card:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.appt-accent-bar { width: 5px; flex-shrink: 0; }

.appt-content { flex: 1; padding: 20px 24px; }

/* TOP ROW */
.appt-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.appt-title-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
.appt-icon { font-size: 32px; }

.appt-test-name {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--gray-800);
  margin: 0 0 4px;
}

.appt-number { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-400); font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; }

.appt-status-wrap { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }

/* STATUS PILLS */
.status-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 5px 14px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: capitalize;
}

.approval-pill {
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: capitalize;
}

.approval-requested { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; }
.approval-approved { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
.approval-rejected { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }

/* META ROW */
.appt-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.meta-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--gray-600);
  background: var(--gray-100);
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.meta-chip .fa { color: var(--accent); font-size: 12px; }

/* INFO ROW */
.appt-info-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.info-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.pay-paid { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
.pay-pending { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; }
.pay-unpaid { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }
.approval-info { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }
.conf-badge { background: #f0fdf4; color: #166534; }

/* NOTES */
.appt-notes {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--gray-600);
  background: var(--gray-50);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--gray-200);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
  font-style: italic;
}

/* REJECTION BANNER */
.rejection-banner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  background: #fef2f2;
  border: 1px solid #fecaca;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #991b1b;
}

/* ACTIONS */
.appt-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.appt-action-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 7px 16px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.btn-view { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }
.btn-view:hover { background: #bfdbfe; }

.btn-cancel { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; }
.btn-cancel:hover { background: #fecaca; }

.btn-report { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
.btn-report:hover { background: #bbf7d0; }

.date-chip {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--gray-400);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ---------- MODAL ---------- */
.modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  z-index: 9999;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 20px;
}

.modal-box {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: 20px;
  max-width: 560px;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  animation: slideUp 0.3s ease;

@keyframes slideUp {

  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.modal-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: var(--white);
}

.modal-header h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; }

.modal-close {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--white);
  font-size: 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1;
  opacity: 0.8;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}

.modal-close:hover { opacity: 1; }

.modal-body { padding: 24px; }

.detail-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 14px;
}

.detail-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}

.detail-item.full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

.detail-key { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gray-400); letter-spacing: 0.4px; }
.detail-val { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--gray-800); }
.detail-val.mono { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; color: var(--primary); }
.detail-val.paid-green { color: var(--success); font-size: 16px; }

.modal-footer {
  padding: 16px 24px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.btn-close-modal {
  padding: 10px 24px;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: var(--white);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.2s;
}

.btn-close-modal:hover { background: #1e3a8a; }

/* ---------- RESPONSIVE ---------- */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .appts-header, .stats-bar, .filter-tabs, .list-controls, .appts-list {
    padding-left: 16px; padding-right: 16px;
  }
  .stats-bar { gap: 10px; }
  .stat-card { min-width: 100px; }
  .appt-top { flex-direction: column; }
  .date-chip { margin-left: 0; }
  .detail-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

}]]></link><name>My Appointments</name><option_schema/><public>true</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {
  data.appointments = [];

  try {
    var currentUser  = gs.getUser();
    var userID       = gs.getUserID();
    var userEmail    = currentUser.getEmail() || '';
    var userName     = gs.getUserName() || '';

    // ── APPROACH 1: Find patient records linked to this sys_user ──────
    var patientSysIds = [];
    var patientMap    = {};  // sys_id → true (dedup)

    // By user reference field
    var patGr = new GlideRecord('x_2133504_medica_0_patient');
    patGr.addQuery('user', userID);
    patGr.query();
    while (patGr.next()) {
      var pid = patGr.getUniqueValue();
      if (!patientMap[pid]) { patientMap[pid] = true; patientSysIds.push(pid); }
    }

    // By email (catches cases where email in form ≠ ServiceNow user email)
    if (userEmail) {
      var patEmailGr = new GlideRecord('x_2133504_medica_0_patient');
      patEmailGr.addQuery('email', userEmail);
      patEmailGr.query();
      while (patEmailGr.next()) {
        var eid = patEmailGr.getUniqueValue();
        if (!patientMap[eid]) { patientMap[eid] = true; patientSysIds.push(eid); }
      }
    }

    // ── APPROACH 2: Find appointments created_by this user ────────────
    // KEY FIX: catches bookings where patient email ≠ logged-in user email
    var apptSysIds   = [];
    var apptMap      = {};  // dedup
    var apptDataMap  = {};  // sys_id → raw appointment GlideRecord data

    var createdByGr = new GlideRecord('x_2133504_medica_0_appointment_table');
    createdByGr.addQuery('created_by', userID);
    createdByGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    createdByGr.query();
    while (createdByGr.next()) {
      var aid = createdByGr.getUniqueValue();
      if (!apptMap[aid]) {
        apptMap[aid] = true;
        apptSysIds.push(aid);

        // Also collect patient IDs from these appointments
        var pRef = createdByGr.getValue('patient');
        if (pRef && !patientMap[pRef]) {
          patientMap[pRef] = true;
          patientSysIds.push(pRef);
        }
      }
    }

    // ── APPROACH 3: Appointments linked to any patient record found ────
    if (patientSysIds.length > 0) {
      var apptPatGr = new GlideRecord('x_2133504_medica_0_appointment_table');
      apptPatGr.addQuery('patient', 'IN', patientSysIds.join(','));
      apptPatGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
      apptPatGr.query();
      while (apptPatGr.next()) {
        var apid = apptPatGr.getUniqueValue();
        if (!apptMap[apid]) {
          apptMap[apid] = true;
          apptSysIds.push(apid);
        }
      }
    }

    if (apptSysIds.length === 0) {
      data.appointments = [];
      return;
    }

    // ── FETCH FULL APPOINTMENT DATA ────────────────────────────────────
    var finalGr = new GlideRecord('x_2133504_medica_0_appointment_table');
    finalGr.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', apptSysIds.join(','));
    finalGr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    finalGr.query();

    while (finalGr.next()) {

      // Get test details
      var testName     = '';
      var testCategory = '';
      var testRef      = finalGr.getValue('test');
      if (testRef) {
        var testGr = new GlideRecord('x_2133504_medica_0_diagnostic_test');
        if (testGr.get(testRef)) {
          testName     = testGr.getValue('test_name') || '';
          testCategory = testGr.getDisplayValue('category') || testGr.getValue('category') || '';
        }
      }

      // Check if report exists
      var hasReport = false;
      var reportGr  = new GlideRecord('x_2133504_medica_0_report_table');
      reportGr.addQuery('appointment', finalGr.getUniqueValue());
      reportGr.setLimit(1);
      reportGr.query();
      if (reportGr.next()) { hasReport = true; }

      // Approved by name
      var approvedByName = '';
      var approvedByRef  = finalGr.getValue('approved_by');
      if (approvedByRef) {
        var approverGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        if (approverGr.get(approvedByRef)) {
          approvedByName = approverGr.getDisplayValue('name') || '';
        }
      }

      // Format dates safely
      var scheduledRaw = finalGr.getValue('scheduled_date') || '';
      var scheduledDisplay = '';
      if (scheduledRaw) {
        try {
          var gdt = new GlideDateTime(scheduledRaw);
          scheduledDisplay = gdt.getLocalDate().getLocalDate();
        } catch(dateErr) {
          scheduledDisplay = scheduledRaw.split(' ')[0] || scheduledRaw;
        }
      }

      var createdOn = finalGr.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on') || '';

      data.appointments.push({
        sys_id:              finalGr.getUniqueValue(),
        appointment_number:  finalGr.getValue('appointment_number') || '',
        status:              finalGr.getValue('status') || 'pending',
        approval_status:     finalGr.getValue('approval_status') || '',
        payment_status:      finalGr.getValue('payment_status') || '',
        scheduled_date:      scheduledRaw,
        scheduled_date_display: scheduledDisplay,
        slot_time:           finalGr.getValue('slot_time') || '',
        total_amount:        parseFloat(finalGr.getValue('total_amount')) || 0,
        notes:               finalGr.getValue('notes') || '',
        rejection_reason:    finalGr.getValue('rejection_reason') || '',
        confirmation_sent:   finalGr.getValue('confirmation_sent') === '1' || finalGr.getValue('confirmation_sent') === true,
        test_name:           testName,
        test_category:       testCategory,
        approved_by_name:    approvedByName,
        has_report:          hasReport,
        created_on_display:  createdOn
      });
    }

    // ── HANDLE CANCEL ACTION ───────────────────────────────────────────
    if (input && input.action === 'cancel_appointment') {
      var cancelGr = new GlideRecord('x_2133504_medica_0_appointment_table');
      if (cancelGr.get(input.appointment_sys_id)) {

        // Verify ownership: created_by OR patient belongs to this user
        var isOwner = false;
        if (cancelGr.getValue('created_by') === userID) {
          isOwner = true;
        } else {
          var cancelPatId = cancelGr.getValue('patient');
          if (cancelPatId && patientSysIds.indexOf(cancelPatId) !== -1) {
            isOwner = true;
          }
        }

        if (isOwner) {
          cancelGr.setValue('status', 'cancelled');
          cancelGr.update();
          data.success = true;

          // Send cancellation email
          try {

            var patGr2 = new GlideRecord('x_2133504_medica_0_patient');

              var emailer = new GlideEmailOutbound();
              emailer.setTo(patEmail2);

              emailer.setBody('<p>Your appointment <strong>' +

        data.error = 'Appointment not found';
      }
    }
